answer_rule: Give the answer on the last line as answer: <value>.

knowledge.title: Production database backup
knowledge.body: The nightly production database backup starts at 02:00 UTC and finishes before 03:30 UTC.

knowledge.title: Staging database backup
knowledge.body: The nightly staging database backup starts at 04:15 UTC. Staging dumps are kept for three days.

knowledge.title: Invoice archive retention
knowledge.body: Invoice PDFs stay in the archive bucket for 400 days, then they are deleted automatically.

knowledge.title: Report archive retention
knowledge.body: Generated report PDFs stay in the archive bucket for 90 days.

knowledge.title: Refund approvals
knowledge.body: Refunds above the standard limit are approved by Heron desk. Smaller refunds need no approval.

knowledge.title: Customer import limits
knowledge.body: Customer import CSV files may be at most 25 MB and 50,000 rows. The import-worker refuses larger files.

knowledge.title: Order import limits
knowledge.body: Order import CSV files may be at most 10 MB.

knowledge.title: Offsite replication window
knowledge.body: Replication of the primary cluster to the Lyra region begins at 01:10 UTC.

knowledge.title: Overdue accounts
knowledge.body: Accounts with invoices unpaid for 60 days are handled by Osprey desk, which sends the final notice.

knowledge.title: Workstation lock policy
knowledge.body: Workstations lock automatically after 7 minutes without input.

knowledge.title: Lost access cards
knowledge.body: A lost access card is reported to Plover desk within one hour so it can be disabled.

knowledge.title: Mail relay rate limit
knowledge.body: The mail-relay service sends at most 120 messages per minute. Extra messages wait in the queue.

knowledge.title: Change freeze
knowledge.body: Production changes are frozen from Friday 16:00 UTC until Monday 08:00 UTC.

knowledge.title: 数据库结构变更审批
knowledge.body: 生产数据库的结构变更需要两名审核人批准后才能执行。

knowledge.title: Error E-4127
knowledge.body: E-4127 is raised by the ledger-sync service when a batch arrives out of order.

knowledge.title: Error E-4172
knowledge.body: E-4172 is raised by the quote-engine service when a price list is missing.

knowledge.title: Metrics endpoint MX-77
knowledge.body: The MX-77 metrics endpoint listens on port 9184 inside the cluster.

knowledge.title: Metrics endpoint MX-71
knowledge.body: The MX-71 metrics endpoint listens on port 9171 inside the cluster.

knowledge.title: Runbook RB-0316
knowledge.body: RB-0316 covers restarting the search-indexer. It is owned by Wren desk.

knowledge.title: Runbook RB-0361
knowledge.body: RB-0361 covers rotating the report-builder logs. It is owned by Kestrel desk.

knowledge.title: Error W-2208
knowledge.body: W-2208 comes from the parcel-router when a carrier rejects a shipping label.

knowledge.title: Parcel router ownership
knowledge.body: The parcel-router is looked after by Kestrel desk.

knowledge.title: Kestrel desk on-call
knowledge.body: Kestrel desk's on-call phone extension is 4471.

knowledge.title: Ledger sync ownership
knowledge.body: The ledger-sync service belongs to Heron desk.

knowledge.title: Lyra region failover
knowledge.body: A failover into the Lyra region needs the approval of the duty manager of the region's host desk.

knowledge.title: Region host desks
knowledge.body: The Lyra region is hosted by Plover desk. The Vega region is hosted by Osprey desk.

knowledge.title: Importer ownership
knowledge.body: The import-worker is maintained by Wren desk.

knowledge.title: Wren desk on-call
knowledge.body: Wren desk's on-call phone extension is 3392.

knowledge.title: Heron desk channels
knowledge.body: Heron desk takes approval requests in #heron-approvals and incident reports in #heron-incidents.

knowledge.title: Refund limits
knowledge.body: The standard refund limit is 500 credits.

knowledge.title: Heron desk stand-up
knowledge.body: Heron desk holds its daily stand-up at 09:30.

knowledge.title: Kestrel desk stand-up
knowledge.body: Kestrel desk holds its daily stand-up at 08:45.

knowledge.title: Osprey desk stand-up
knowledge.body: Osprey desk holds its daily stand-up at 10:00.

knowledge.title: Wren desk stand-up
knowledge.body: Wren desk holds its daily stand-up at 09:15.

knowledge.title: Ledger sync maintenance
knowledge.body: The ledger-sync maintenance window lasts 40 minutes every Sunday.

knowledge.title: Parcel router maintenance
knowledge.body: The parcel-router maintenance window lasts 25 minutes every Sunday.

knowledge.title: Quote engine maintenance
knowledge.body: The quote-engine maintenance window lasts 90 minutes every Sunday.

knowledge.title: Mail relay maintenance
knowledge.body: The mail-relay maintenance window lasts 15 minutes every Sunday.

knowledge.title: Heron desk tooling budget
knowledge.body: Heron desk may spend 1200 credits a month on tooling.

knowledge.title: Kestrel desk tooling budget
knowledge.body: Kestrel desk may spend 800 credits a month on tooling.

knowledge.title: Osprey desk tooling budget
knowledge.body: Osprey desk may spend 950 credits a month on tooling.

knowledge.title: Wren desk tooling budget
knowledge.body: Wren desk may spend 600 credits a month on tooling.
